correctness.rationale: Derives renewed hitting means for left, right, and either endpoint using ODE Laplace transforms; includes visited-set-preserving inclusion-exclusion. Hyperbolic algebra gives F_c(t), whose derivative numerator P_c(w) has leading coefficient 3-4c^2<0 and constant (c^2-1)^2>0, hence exactly one positive root yielding only an interior maximum. Boundary/midpoint difference factors as (c-1)(2c^2-c-2)/c and proves the unique global transition. P_c(1)=5(c^2-1)^2-1 and P_c(c^2)=1-2c^2 prove local morphology. Standard-library checker passed 7159 deterministic comparisons incl. independent Linn-Lawley formula. No reliance on finite enumeration for theorem.

value.rationale: At fixed physical reset rate, where to reset to minimize complete coverage time is a natural design question in one-dimensional exploration. The theorem gives an all-location global classification and closed algebraic jump threshold, rules out intermediate optima, and proves a separate local threshold at which the central site becomes a metastable design. These are structural and experimental/numerical predictions beyond evaluation of an already known single parameter formula.
